description:
SAIC is seeking an AI Data Engineer to join our team at Fort Belvoir, Virginia.

 The AI Data Engineer will design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and architectures to support AI/ML workloads for the Army Intelligence & Security Enterprise (AISE). This role ensures data availability, quality, security, and operational integration to enable advanced analytics and decision-making. The AI Data Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams, optimize data workflows, and contribute to intelligence solutions.

 Key Responsibilities: 

 
 Translate business requirements into logical data models to support entity relationships and data flows.

 Design and implement scalable data pipelines for AI and machine learning workloads.

 Develop and maintain data architectures to ensure data quality, availability, and security.

 Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to meet AI/ML data requirements.

 Optimize data workflows for real-time analytics and decision-making.

 Ensure adherence to data governance policies and security protocols.

 Stay current on data engineering, AI, and machine learning advancements.

 Support the operational deployment and integration of AI/ML solutions to enhance intelligence capabilities.

 Analyze complex data challenges and deliver practical, innovative technical solutions aligned with organizational goals.

 Engage frequently with internal and external stakeholders to resolve technical issues and deliver impactful solutions.

 Contribute to the successful delivery of programs and projects.

 

 Required Education: 
 Bachelors degree and five (5) years or more related experience; Masters and three (3) years or more experience; four (4) years of experience considered in lieu of degree.
 Qualifications: 
 5+ years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, data architecture, or similar roles.
 Expertise with Palantir Foundry; particularly with Ontologies, Object Types, Data Pipelines, and AIP tools).
 Strong knowledge of data pipeline design, ETL processes, and database management.
 Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, SQL, and TypeScript; and object-oriented development.
 Experience utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) for tasks like NLP, text generation, and conversational AI.
 Familiarity with data governance, security practices, and compliance standards.
 Clearance: 
 Candidate must have an active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain a TS/SCI with Poly.  
 
 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives. 
 
 

 We are approximately 23,000 strong; driven by mission, united by purpose, and inspired by opportunities. SAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC has annual revenues of approximately $7.3 billion. For more information, visit  saic.com . For ongoing news, please visit our  newsroom .
